_comment: LLAMA NATIVE-ACTUATION frozen spec (2026-09-24): the RPBE recursion node is the native CCM merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t with depth D=L and Z_t = M_t; the actuated params are the conditional LoRA of the OFFICIAL merged host (released Step-2 compression adapter) + the COMP/SUM SeparatedEmbedding rows.  Theta_0 = the official merged model (Step-1 default-LoRA foundation merged into the base + released Step-2 adapter + SeparatedEmbedding COMP rows — build_official_host).  User ruling 2026-09-24: fork the llama merged model and run 10 treewise windows (S4 supervisor, no-warmup, checkpoint every 2 windows) on the seetacloud A100-80G box (connect.nma1.seetacloud.com:19657).
frozen_source: Qwen3 native-actuation frozen spec (frozen_method_qwen3_native.json) re-instantiated on the llama official merged host; the host semantics are the frozen_method.json official-host protocol (build_official_host, review round 7)

actuation.scope: conditional LoRA (released Step-2 adapter) + COMP/SUM comp_embeddings rows (SeparatedEmbedding); recursion node = native merge step (M_{t-1}, u_t) -> M_t, depth D=L; Z_t = M_t
actuation.theta0: official merged host: llama-7b-hf + Step-1 foundation (llama-7b-no, merged) + released Step-2 compression adapter (llama-7b-no-online-merge_recur-ntok2) + SeparatedEmbedding COMP rows (build_official_host; fp32 throughout per review round 7)
actuation.projection_space: AdamW proposal space (same as the qwen3 native line): d_0 = shadow-AdamW joint proposal from g_task + lambda*g_pred; d* = argmin 1/2||d-d_0||^2 s.t. q_i^T d >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task||; theta <- theta + d* written back directly
actuation.lambda_fact: lambda does NOT affect the pure half-space feasibility region (cancels on both sides); lambda is meaningful only through the joint proposal center d_0

backbone.dtype: fp32 (the official host path keeps fp32 throughout — SeparatedEmbedding comp rows + peft conditional-LoRA forward)
backbone.host_path: official host ONLY: build_official_host (Step-1 foundation merged + released Step-2 compression adapter + SeparatedEmbedding COMP rows); the legacy resize host is not the DailyDialog method

adapter.lora_r_note: the released Step-2 compression adapter's conditional LoRA (loaded through peft_custom, NOT re-wrapped — the trainer skips wrap_lora under --official-host).  The COMP/SUM rows stay trainable (official protocol trains them).

lambda_calibration.rule: same as the qwen3 native line: r_eff = lambda * ||d_pred|| / ||d_task|| ~ 0.1 measured at theta_0 (the official merged host) on the first closed window, native proposal-space (lr=1 direction space), then frozen.
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: Calibrated 2026-09-24 (llama official merged host, native proposal-space r_eff at theta_0): r_eff = 1.0026, derived lambda = 0.1/1.0026 = 0.0997.  Matches qwen3 (0.0998, r_eff 1.002) and gemma4 (0.0999, r_eff 1.001) — the proposal-space r_eff on native compression params is ~1 across all three hosts.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_v) fixed adapter; llama host lifts the memory from all attention heads (32, head_dim = hidden / heads)
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: four independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r); depth bucket b(L_v) modulates the future signature phi_r.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch; the fixed ridge keeps only its numerical-safety role.

gamma.placement: NOT ATTACHED in native mode (kept for the enforce_frozen gamma.hidden binding)

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with k>=4), not a mechanical microbatch count
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the two native arms

training.steps_note: User ruling 2026-09-24: 10 treewise windows from the merged model (no-warmup, checkpoint every 2 windows -> s2..s10 + final).  trainable = official conditional LoRA + COMP rows (backbone frozen, NO Gamma).

official_protocol.data_stream: shuffled epoch loop (each dialogue exactly once per epoch)
official_protocol.micro_batch_note: RPBE arms require micro-batch 1 (two-pass replay protocol)

training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)

proposal_space.center: d_0 = shadow AdamW proposal of g_joint = g_task + lambda*g_pred (moments read from the CURRENT optimizer state, never stepped)
proposal_space.constraint_norm: ||d_task|| = shadow AdamW proposal norm of the PURE task gradient (snapshotted before the aux accumulation)
proposal_space.half_spaces: q_i^T d* >= -kappa*||q_i||*||d_task|| (lower bound in update space)
proposal_space.write_back: theta <- theta + d*; optimizer moments updated with the true-value clipped joint gradient; scheduler/scaler cadence identical to the task-only arm
proposal_space.cert_fail: whole-window skip including the task update (inherited gamma-line semantics), cert_skip_steps recorded

training.seeds_note: seed 0 only (same ruling as the qwen3 line)
training.eval: eval_llama_pooled_B.py (protocol B pooled, official host semantics) — exact script/args to be confirmed at eval time
training.checkpoint_every_note: user ruling 2026-09-24: checkpoint every 2 windows (10-window budget -> s2..s10 + final)
training.schedule_note: warmup/cosine over 1000 steps (warmup ratio 0.03); --no-warmup on the fork: the first window steps at the peak lr and the cosine descends from there

sampling.q_alpha_note: q_L ∝ n_L^q_alpha, q_alpha=1 (natural frequency) with the replay cap — same convention as the qwen3 native line
sampling.rule: depth-stratified legal cuts with natural-frequency depth weights + per-dialogue replay cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id); L=1 dialogues carry task CE only.

official_host.note: llama native REQUIRES --official-host (the merged official model): the trainer refuses the ours arm without it.  The CLI also needs --foundation <llama-7b-no> and --official-adapter <llama-7b-no-online-merge_recur-ntok2> (build_official_host reads both; on the seetacloud box they live under /root/autodl-tmp/result/dialog/).

freeze_host.scope: native mode freezes the BACKBONE only: trainable = conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM rows; the trainer refuses --freeze-host / --rpbe-gamma-only / --rpbe-lr under native actuation
